# SOUQ // Autonomous Agent Commerce & Token-Saving Storefront (v0.3.0)
> Machine-readable catalog for LLMs, autonomous agents, and AI coding assistants.
> Official Public Server: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run

## Overview
SOUQ provides **16 paid analytical micro-services** plus **`souq_account_status`** (free MCP discovery & credit balance tool).
Agents can evaluate **1 free trial call per 24h per IP**, then pay via:
1. **Prepaid `X-API-Key` Credits (Recommended)**: Fund >= $0.50 Base USDC once via `POST /api/credits/topup` (or 1-click browser wallet at `/#topup`) — zero per-call signing gas.
2. **Polar.sh Merchant of Record Checkout**: Create a checkout session for ready SKUs at `POST /api/checkout/create` and exchange one-time tokens at `GET /api/checkout/claim`.
3. **Per-Call HTTP 402 (`x402-v1.0`) Base L2 USDC**: Transfer USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`) to `0x71C8F7E4E98a9667793d5B52b71C8A36e65F79bF` on Base (Chain ID 8453) and retry with `X-Payment-Tx: <tx_hash>`.

## Server Endpoints
- Streamable HTTP MCP Endpoint (`POST` JSON-RPC 2.0 / `DELETE` 204 / `GET` 405 notice): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/mcp
- Tool Execution Endpoint (`POST`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/tools/call
- Mint / Top-Up Prepaid API Key (`POST`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/credits/topup
- Check Credit Balance (`GET` with `X-API-Key`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/credits/balance
- Digital Products & Credit Packs (`GET`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/products
- Polar Checkout Create (`POST`) & Claim (`GET`): `/api/checkout/create`, `/api/checkout/claim`
- Public Catalog (`GET`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/catalog
- Public Telemetry (`GET`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/stats
- Cyber Threat Intel (`GET`): https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/api/cyber/threat-intel
- Machine Registry: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/.well-known/mcp.json
- A2A Agent Card: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/.well-known/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI 3.1 Spec: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/openapi.json
- Health Probe: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/health
- Storefront Top-Up UI: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run/#topup

## MCP Discovery Tool (Free)
0. `souq_account_status` ($0.00) — Inspects prepaid `X-API-Key` credits, Base USDC payment wallet, and tool pricing. Params: `{}`.

## Available Paid Micro-Service Tools (All 16)
1. `token_context_compressor` ($0.01 USDC) — Compresses HTML, JSON, code, logs, or markdown by 60–95%. Params: `raw_content` (required), `max_compression` (bool, default `true`), `mode` (`"auto"|"html"|"json"|"code"|"log"|"logs"|"markdown"|"prose"`, default `"auto"`), `target_ratio` (number in `(0.05, 0.95)`).
2. `ast_structural_slicer` ($0.02 USDC) — Extracts a single AST function or class from Python source code. Params: `source_code` (required), `target_symbol` (required).
3. `quant_microstructure_radar` ($0.02 USDC) — Live order book depth, spread bps, OBI, and cascade risk score. Params: `symbol` (default `"BTC/USDT"`).
4. `cross_exchange_arbitrage_scanner` ($0.03 USDC) — Spot vs Perpetual Futures basis spreads & annualized funding APR. Params: `symbol` (default `"BTC/USDT"`).
5. `orderbook_slippage_simulator` ($0.02 USDC) — Walks 100 order book levels for VWAP, slippage bps, and impact. Params: `symbol` (default `"BTC/USDT"`), `side` (`"BUY"|"SELL"`, default `"BUY"`), `trade_size_usd` (default `10000.0`).
6. `smart_money_whale_flow_radar` ($0.03 USDC) — Aggregates block trades and limit walls for Whale Accumulation Index. Params: `symbol` (default `"BTC/USDT"`), `block_threshold_usd` (default `50000.0`).
7. `prediction_market_arbitrage_radar` ($0.03 USDC) — Polymarket crypto markets vs 30d realized-vol Black-Scholes probabilities. Params: `asset` (default `"BTC"`), `limit` (integer, default `5`).
8. `dev_api_cheatsheet_vault` ($0.01 USDC) — High-density API schemas & snippets. Params: `ecosystem` (`"openai"|"anthropic"|"stripe"|"base_evm"|"fastmcp"|"mcp"|"duckdb"`, default `"openai"`).
9. `daily_tech_ai_trends_radar` ($0.01 USDC) — Live GitHub AI repos, HackerNews top stories, and arXiv cs.AI/cs.CL. Params: `force_refresh` (bool, default `false`).
10. `synthetic_schema_verifier` ($0.01 USDC) — Validates JSON payloads against expected type schemas. Params: `data` (object, required), `schema` (object, required).
11. `prompt_injection_firewall` ($0.01 USDC) — Detects prompt injection, DAN jailbreaks, and prompt exfiltration. Params: `text` (required), `strict_mode` (bool, default `false`).
12. `smart_contract_honeypot_radar` ($0.03 USDC) — Audits Solidity source OR live Base `0x...` contracts for honeypots, hidden mints, and reentrancy. Params: `source_code` (default `""`), `contract_address`, `token_symbol` (default `"TKN"`).
13. `secret_leak_scanner` ($0.01 USDC) — High-entropy credential scanner catching AWS, OpenAI, Anthropic, and EVM private keys. Params: `content` (required), `entropy_threshold` (number, default `4.2`).
14. `deep_ast_vulnerability_auditor` ($0.03 USDC) — Deep Python AST scanner for SQLi, SSRF, YAML/pickle RCE. Params: `source_code` (required).
15. `api_attack_surface_scanner` ($0.02 USDC) — Audits live HTTPS endpoints for security headers, CORS misconfiguration, and exposure. Params: `target_url` (required), `headers_to_check` (optional object mapping header name -> value, for offline inspection).
